title: Ing Propeta da ring Bunduk a Meukit
intro: keng mabagsik a disyerto ning minunang Arabia, metung a pigura ing linwal kareng taung pikabaluan keng karelang pambihirang pangagawa. Ding karelang pibale-bale makatalakad la king matibe batu, oneng mas matibe la pusu kesa karing bunduk a inukit da. Metung a banal a tubud ing dinatang a maki metung, makapagmulalang tanda — dapot ing pamagmaragul at pamaglaban meging sangkan ning mabilis at makatakut a bunga. Malyari meng akilala ing marangal a talasuyu a ding memalen na pinili da ing kasiran kesa king patnube?
clues: Mitubud ku bilang babala karing memalen ku, a mamaus karela king pamanyamba king Metung a Dios.
Deng tau ku manuknangan la kareng makabaldugan a batu, gagawang mangasanting a tuknangan kareng gilid ning bunduk.
Metung a makapagmulalang babaing kamelyu ing linual king matibe batu king kanakung panalangin, metung a malino tanda ibat king Mayupaya.
Sinabi ku karing memalen ku king idake de ing danum king babaing kamelyu at e re panasakitan.
Migplanu lang migplanu ding memalen ku laban king babaing kamelyu at pinutut de ing bitis na.
Metung a makapangilabut a ayun ing menabu karing memalen ku, at melakuan lang alang kimut karing karelang tuknangan.

arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَثَمُودُ
verse: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd deny [their prophets], (22:42)
